findings.evidence: 2014 PDF page 5 and historical PDF page 5 describe the final daily transmission as an ASCII list of submissions disseminated since 06:00 that day.
findings.inference: An authentic, complete daily audit with an exact target entry may support dissemination-day evidence once its provenance and applicable day semantics are verified.
findings.limitation: No target daily audit file is cached; public web availability is unknown. The specification does not equate Feed .nc.tar.gz date labels to this audit.

findings.limitation: This control-block definition does not establish the website SGML acceptance field timezone and daylight-saving mapping, or make acceptance equal public availability.
